design.fixture: three-bus radial feeder with nonlinear voltage magnitudes and branch-drop projections

qualification.claim: On the nonlinear three-bus radial feeder truth fixture, the phase-only formulation preserves the physical endpoint and remains locally solved, but uses more recorded Ipopt work than the reference in this run.
qualification.scope: Two fresh reference and two fresh phase-only Ipopt solves with fixed voltage-magnitude bases and two declared branch-drop projections.
